name: B10-0153/2024 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified MON 94804, pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow imports of a genetically modified maize, called MON 94804, for food and feed. The maize was modified to make it shorter. Parliament says the safety checks are incomplete, especially about unexpected effects of the modification and about lower levels of plant hormones called gibberellins. It also says most Member States did not back the plan. Parliament cannot block the plan itself; it can only ask the Commission to drop it.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to withdraw the plan and start again.
- **Who it affects:** Companies importing this maize, food and feed businesses, and consumers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw or go ahead.
